text:
sanjay: Heads up — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need owners for backports and any outstanding cherry-picks. Cutoff for new feature PRs is 09:30 PT. Please drop PR numbers here.

lina: quick q: can we move to 11:00 PT? infra has a rolling change at 10:30 that might interfere with validation. :clock1:

sanjay: prefer to keep 10:00 to stay aligned with ops handoff, but if infra team confirms they can finish earlier we can slide. if we move, docs team needs ~36h for version bump.

mark: I have one cherry-pick: #6123 (kv cache restore bug). I'll own the backport and open the PR right after branch is created.

olga: picking up #6200 (embeddings perf regression). plan: create a backport branch and run the perf test suite. will post PR link here.

sam: reminder: backports must include a short changelog entry and a regression test where applicable. see ops doc: https://redwood.example/internal/release-backports (internal)

devops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI — release branch creation sequence we run:
```
fetch origin
checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
push origin release/1.16
```
(we'll run CI + smoke in parallel, expect ~15m validation)

sanjay: thanks all. plan: create branch at 10:00 PT (2191112300) unless we hear objections in next 30m. when you open backport PRs, use prefix "cherry-pick/" and include the original issue/PR number in the title, e.g. `cherry-pick/6123 - restore kv cache`

mark: noted — will post PR link once created.

olga: will do the same.

sanjay: final reminder for docs/version bump: add an entry under `1.16.0-rc` in docs/CHANGELOG.md and ping @docs when PR is up. I'll proceed with 10:00 PT branch cut. :shipit:
